stories.title: Fflint Wrecsam MS presses First Minister on A55 and A494 investment
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has made no specific commitment to road investment on the A55, A483 and A494 after a north Wales MS raised their importance for businesses in Flintshire and Wrexham. stories.title: Nine Welsh health and care organisations write to Welsh Government demanding action on corridor care
stories.summary: Nine health and care organisations have written to the Welsh Government’s health minister demanding urgent action on corridor care, the practice of treating patients in hospital corridors, waiting rooms and car parks because no clinical space is available. stories.title: Why Natural Resources Wales is pumping extra water into the River Dee this week
stories.summary: Natural Resources Wales has released extra water into the River Dee to protect fish as temperatures locally are forecast to reach 37°C on Thursday, with amber heat warnings in place for both Wednesday and Thursday. stories.title: Final plans in place for Connah’s Quay Festival at Wepre Park this Saturday
stories.summary: Final preparations are under way for the Connah’s Quay Festival at Wepre Park, with North Wales Police visiting the site on Tuesday to go over the layout ahead of Saturday’s event. stories.title: Fire service warns of grass fire and open water risks during north Wales heatwave
stories.summary: North Wales Fire and Rescue Service is urging residents to take extra care with barbecues, fires and open water after an amber warning for extreme heat was issued for the region. Paul Kay, Head of Fire Safety at North Wales Fire and Rescue Service, said dry conditions meant even a small spark could spread quickly.
